messages.横屏游玩，工位和按钮会更清楚。: Play in landscape for a clearer kitchen and controls.
messages.先看操作说明，准备好了就开店。: Check the controls, then open when you are ready.
messages.去服务商获取 Key ↗: Get a key from your provider ↗
messages.记住此设备（共用电脑请勿勾选）: Remember on this device (not on shared computers)
messages.下一局使用并保存跨局记忆: Use and save memory from the next round
messages.尚未配置 · 不使用开发者 Key: Not configured · no developer key is used
messages.抛掷 · 长按空格 + 左键 / 右键 + 左键: Throw · hold Space + left click / right then left click
messages.按住空格 · 左键选落点: Hold Space · left click a destination
messages.抛掷已准备 · 左键选落点: Ready to throw · left click a destination
messages.靠近工位或物品，再按空格: Move near a station or item, then tap Space
messages.把脏餐盘放入水槽: Put the dirty plate in the sink
messages.到冰箱取一份生肉: Take raw meat from the fridge
messages.去垃圾桶丢弃手中食物: Discard the held food at the bin
messages.倒掉手中锅里的食物: Empty the food from the held pot
messages.用手中的干净盘盛出地上锅里的菜: Plate food from the pot on the floor
messages.端锅走近，给队友手中的干净盘装菜: Bring the pot to your teammate and fill their clean plate
messages.当前无需继续。: There is no paused round to resume.
messages.手中物品已变化，请重新按空格: Your held item changed. Tap Space again.
messages.请靠近工位或物品，再按空格操作: Move near a station or item, then tap Space.
messages.没有可用落点，或此物品不能抛掷: No landing space, or this item cannot be thrown
messages.这是上一局的操作，请刷新页面。: This action belongs to an old round. Refresh the page.
messages.请在开局前或结算后修改下一局调用上限。: Change the call limit before a round or after it ends.
messages.调用上限须为 1–2000 的整数。: The call limit must be an integer from 1 to 2000.
messages.请在开局前或结算后修改记忆设置，保证一局内条件一致。: Change memory settings before a round or after it ends.
messages.无法保存记忆设置，请检查本地文件权限。: Cannot save memory settings. Check local file permissions.
messages.正在测试连接，请等测试完成后再开局。: Wait for the connection test to finish before starting.
messages.请先打开 API 设置，连接你自己的账号。不会使用开发者的 Key。: Connect your own account in Settings first. No developer key will be used.
messages.请在开局前或结算后修改连接；请完成当前对局后再修改。: Change your connection before a round or after the current round ends.
messages.对局已变化，请重试。: The round changed. Please try again.
messages.无法清除保存的连接，请检查文件权限。: Cannot clear saved credentials. Check file permissions.
messages.本局已结束，但跨局记录未能保存；请检查本地文件权限。: The round ended, but memory could not be saved. Check file permissions.
messages.使用你自己的 API 账号，调用费用由该账号承担。: Use your own API account. Calls are billed to that account.
messages.：当前厨房原型围绕 Jev 开发；其他模型也可使用，响应速度和配合方式可能不同。: : this kitchen prototype was developed around Jev. Other models work too; response times and cooperation may differ.
messages.建议使用响应快的模型；过慢或无效的动作不会执行。: Choose a responsive model. Actions that arrive too late or are invalid will not run.
messages.默认只在本次服务运行期间使用。记住后以明文保存在这台电脑的本地配置文件；Key: By default, credentials last only until the local service stops. Remembering stores them in plain text on this computer. Keys are excluded from game logs and demo packages.
messages.测试连接会发送一次小型 API 请求，可能产生少量费用。: Testing sends one small API request and may incur a charge.
messages.保留最近 3 局的有限事件片段，让搭档自行判断如何配合，不预设你的习惯。不同接口: Keep limited event excerpts from the last 3 rounds. Your teammate decides how to adapt; no habits are assigned to you. Providers and models have separate memory.
messages.记录保存在本机，旧局片段会随决策请求发送给你选择的模型服务，增加输入 token: Records stay on this computer. Past excerpts are sent with decisions to your chosen model, adding input tokens and cost. When disabled, memory is neither read nor saved. Aborted rounds are not saved.
messages.默认每局 200 次，失败请求也计入；达限后不再请求，已有动作继续，玩家仍可操作: Default: 200 calls per round, including failed requests. At the limit, new requests stop; existing actions and player controls continue. This setting lasts until the service stops. Connection tests are counted separately and may cost money. Token totals include usage reported by successful replies, not the full bill. Check your provider for charges.
messages.导出当前局摘要和最近 80 条动作事件。不会附带 Key、接口地址、模型名称文本: Export a round summary and the latest 80 action events. Keys, endpoint URLs, model-name text, memory, full requests and private logs are excluded. The file downloads locally and is not uploaded.
messages.这个旧页面还不支持 API 配置，请使用新版服务。: This page does not support API settings. Please update the service.
messages.请在开局前或结算后更换 API；请完成当前对局后再修改。: Change the API before a round or after it ends. Please finish this round first.
messages.配置已清除。下次开局需要重新连接。: Credentials cleared. Connect again before the next round.
messages.连接成功！返回厨房即可开局，费用由你的 API 账号承担。: Connected! Return to the kitchen to start. Your API account pays for calls.
messages.请求超时。请检查网络后重试。: Request timed out. Check your connection and try again.
messages.请求超时，请重新打开设置确认结果。: Request timed out. Reopen Settings to check the result.
messages.请检查下方内容；点击下载后才会保存文件。: Review the content below. The file is saved only when you click Download.
messages.按住方向键移动，松开停止。鼠标点地面或工位可走近；键盘移动会接管当前动作。: Hold WASD or arrow keys to move; release to stop. Click the floor or a station to walk there. Keyboard movement takes over the current action.
messages.靠近后按空格，底部文字会显示将执行的动作：取料、放到案板、切菜、拿起、下锅、装盘: Move close and tap Space. The bottom hint shows the action: fetch, put on a board, chop, pick up, cook, plate, wash or serve. Tap Space while working to stop and keep progress.
messages.身边没有可操作工位时，手中物品放在脚边，空手拾取最近的地面物品。拿干净盘靠近地上: Away from usable stations, tap Space to put down a held item or pick up the nearest item with empty hands. A clean plate can take cooked food from a pot on the floor. Move away from stations to put an item on the floor.
messages.空格按住约 0.3 秒，再左键点落点；松开取消。也可右键准备，再左键抛出或右键取: Hold Space for about 0.3 seconds, then left-click a destination; release to cancel. Or right-click to prepare, left-click to throw, and right-click again to cancel. Range: 7 tiles; walls stop the throw. Only raw or chopped, unplated ingredients can be thrown. Plates, plated food, pots and extinguishers can be put down and picked up, but not thrown. Busy teammates or those holding something cannot catch.
messages.干净盘才可装菜。脏盘回收点取盘 → 放入水槽 → 空手洗碗 → 取净盘。没盘时可: Only clean plates can hold food. Collect a dirty plate → put it in the sink → wash with empty hands → take the clean plate. Without a plate, use empty hands to lift the whole pot. Taking it off the stove stops heating; return empty pots to the stove.
messages.拿食材靠近垃圾桶按空格会销毁，扣 2 元；端锅则倒掉锅里的食物，保留空锅。灭火器: Hold food near a bin and tap Space to discard it for a ¥2 penalty. If holding a pot, its food is discarded and the pot stays. Take the extinguisher at the top right, then tap Space near a burning stove.
messages.暂停会停止锅火、订单和双方动作。从暂停菜单继续经营、重新开局、打开设置或查看本说: Pause freezes cooking, orders and both chefs. The pause menu lets you resume, restart, open Settings or read Controls. Restart immediately begins a new round with the same configuration and speed. Change API, memory and call limits before a round or after it ends.
messages.请先从下方「设置」连接自己的 API，再开始经营。: Connect your own API in Settings below before starting.
messages.只能抛生食材或切好的原料；餐盘、带盘菜、锅和工具请放下或搬运。: Only raw or chopped ingredients can be thrown. Carry or put down plates, plated food, pots and tools.
messages.新版页面已就绪，厨房服务仍在保留旧对局。\n服务更新后会自动连接，请先完成更新确:
The new page is ready, but the service still holds the old round.
Confirm the update; the page will reconnect automatically.
messages.暂时连接不上厨房，请稍后重试。\n连接中断时，游戏会自动暂停。:
Cannot connect to the kitchen. Please try again.
The game pauses automatically when disconnected.
messages.靠近 Jeff，按空格给他手中的干净盘装菜。: Move near Jeff and tap Space to fill the clean plate he is holding.
messages.本局 AI 调用已达上限；已有动作继续。你可继续玩或暂停，下局可调整上限。: AI call limit reached. Existing actions continue. Keep playing or pause; adjust the limit for the next round.
messages.锅火和订单都按下了暂停。\n准备好了，就和 Jeff 接着做菜。:
Cooking and orders are paused.
Resume cooking with Jeff when you are ready.
messages.页面已断开，厨房自动暂停。回来后点击继续。: Disconnected: the kitchen paused. Click Resume when you return.
messages.厨房已暂停，你和 Jeff 的动作、锅与订单倒计时都已停下。: Kitchen paused: both chefs, cooking and order timers are frozen.
messages.离开页面，厨房已自动暂停。: Kitchen paused because the page was hidden.
messages.厨房已暂停：运行出现异常，请重新开局。: Kitchen paused after an error. Please restart the round.
messages.AI 搭档暂时连接不上，正在重试。你仍可以操作或先暂停。: AI teammate disconnected; retrying. You can keep playing or pause.
messages.案板有食材正在飞入，本次放置取消: An ingredient is landing on the board; placement cancelled
messages.队友已移动或物品变化，装盘取消: Teammate moved or items changed; plating cancelled
messages.装盘时队友或物品变化，物品保持原样: Teammate or items changed; nothing transferred
messages.地上锅或手中餐盘已变化，装盘取消: The floor pot or held plate changed; plating cancelled
messages.当前厨房不支持方向移动: Directional movement is unavailable in this kitchen.
messages.仅允许本机页面访问。: Only local pages may access this service.
messages.仅允许本机页面操作。: Only local pages may control this service.
messages.请选择页面中的游戏节奏。: Choose a game speed shown on the page.
messages.先开始或继续本局，再点击动作。: Start or resume the round before choosing an action.
messages.动作信息无效，请重试。: Invalid action data. Please try again.
messages.刚才的食材或工位状态变了，请按更新后的按钮操作。: The ingredient or station changed. Use the updated action.
messages.没有读到可用的本地 Jev 配置，请检查 .env。厨房尚未开始计时。: No usable local Jev configuration. Check .env. The kitchen timer has not started.
messages.对局已变化，连接未保存。: The round changed. The connection was not saved.
messages.手中物品自动放到地上: held item is put on the floor
messages.切配进度保留；锅继续加热: prep progress kept; pot keeps heating
messages.离开灶台停止加热，占手持位: stops heating off the stove; occupies your hands
messages.糊菜或无订单会被差评: burnt food or no matching order earns a bad review
messages.没有订单在等这道菜会扣钱，糊太久会被拒收: serving a dish no order is waiting for costs money; a dish burnt too long is refused
messages.随后仍须清理糊菜: burnt food must still be cleared
messages.去垃圾桶 2丢弃手中食物: Discard the held food at bin 2
messages.每个房间中央最近空地各一人，左右随机分配: One chef spawns on the nearest free floor tile to each room center; left/right assignment is random.
messages.工位可从相邻可达空地就近操作。设备和墙不可穿过；角色之间可穿过。按实际距离走可通: Use the nearest reachable adjacent side of a station. Walls and equipment block movement; chefs can pass through each other. Follow the shortest navigable route by actual distance, straight when clear and with body clearance around obstacles. Changing tasks preserves the current travel position.
messages.每格放一份，放下会选脚下或相邻空地。地面不能切配或加热，但可拿干净盘盛出地上锅里: One item per tile; drop selects the current or an adjacent free tile. Floor items cannot be chopped or heated, but a clean plate can take cooked food from a pot on the floor. Without space, keep the held item.
messages.同一本地玩家与当前接口/模型的过往已结束对局。事件为按时间抽样的事实，非完整录像: Past completed rounds for the same local player and provider/model. Events are facts sampled over time, not a full replay or inferred preferences. Item IDs and coordinates belong only to their original rounds.
messages.状态已变化，该动作已失效；请重新查看选项: State changed; this action is no longer valid. Review the available choices.
messages.回复已过期、任务已变化或游戏已暂停: Reply expired, task changed, or game paused
messages.当前无法执行；输入 m 查看可用动作: Action unavailable; review the available choices.
messages.双击同一方向键冲刺: Double-tap the same direction to sprint
messages.走近，把食材加入队友手中的盘（容器留在原持有者手中）: Approach and add food to the teammate's held plate (containers stay with their holders)
messages.把切好的牛肉放入地上空锅（离灶不加热）: Load chopped beef into the empty floor pot (no heating off stove)
messages.地上锅或手中食材已变化，入锅取消: Floor pot or held ingredient changed; loading cancelled
messages.选中目标暂不可操作，请靠近或检查物品状态: Selected target cannot be used now; move closer or check items
messages.请靠近选中的出餐口: Move closer to the selected serving hatch
messages.地上物品已变化，请重新选择: Ground item changed; select it again
messages.与地上的锅交换（各自保留锅内食物）: Swap with the pot on the floor (contents stay in their own pots)
messages.火势失控，本局结束: Fire out of control. Round ended.
messages.工位有食材正在飞入，本次放置取消: An ingredient is landing on the workstation; placement cancelled
messages.工位可从相邻可达空地就近操作。墙、设备和厨师不能穿过；普通走路可穿过地面食物，自: Work from an accessible adjacent side. Walls, stations and chefs block movement; loose food does not. Automatic movement detours or waits for a chef. Sprinting does not knock chefs away.
messages.放下优先选脚下或相邻空格。冲刺每次最多推动散落食材0.25格，允许食物重叠；盘子: Place items on the current or an adjacent empty floor cell. Each sprint can nudge loose ingredients up to 0.25 tile. Food may overlap; plates and pots stay still. Contact never assembles, launches or damages food. No chopping or heating on the floor.
messages.工位可从相邻可达空地就近操作。墙和设备不能穿过；厨师接触时贴边滑动并缓慢推挤，冲: Stations can be operated from adjacent reachable floor. Walls and equipment block movement. Chefs slide along contact and gently push; each sprint can bump another chef by up to a quarter tile. Humans and AI share the same contact rules, without planning a new route around chefs. Ordinary walking passes through floor food.
messages.走到对方厨师当前的位置（接触时会推挤）: Walk to the other chef's current position (contact pushes)
